title: The Own Goal — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational absurdist 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Spanish French language learning trilingual football
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The own goal is not a mistake — well, it is a mistake
But it is a very specific kind of mistake
The kind where you did everything right
And it still ended up wrong

[Verse 2 — Español]
El defensa que marcó el autogol [The defender who scored the own goal]
Estaba tratando de despejar el peligro [Was trying to clear the danger]
El balón simplemente tenía ideas diferentes [The ball simply had different ideas]
El balón siempre ha tenido ideas diferentes [The ball has always had different ideas]
El balón no está interesado en las intenciones [The ball is not interested in intentions]

[Chorus — English]
The own goal says — I was trying to help
The own goal says — I had the best intentions
The own goal says — the ball went that way
The net says nothing — the net just holds it

[Bridge — Français]
Chas disait — le but contre son camp est le moment le plus honnête du football [Chas said — the own goal is the most honest moment in football]
Parce que le joueur ne peut blâmer personne d'autre [Because the player cannot blame anyone else]
Pas vraiment [Not really]
Pas longtemps [Not for long]
Pas pendant que le ralenti tourne encore [Not while the replay is still running]

[Verse 3 — English]
The walk back to the halfway line after an own goal
Is one of the longest walks in sport

[Outro — EN/ES/FR]
The own goal
El autogol [The own goal]
Le but contre son camp [The own goal]
That's my boy
